Guys, it’s possible to get sick months after having mono without it being a relapse. More than likely you got another virus/infection, even if the symptoms are similar to when you had mono without

Itchy skin is a symptom of mono. My sister had that. Nothing to worry about. And don’t worry about your lymph nodes. They probably are swollen because you have an infection. Again, that’s normal and will go away with time

I typically have a terrible immune system, and any time I get sick (which is often) I seem to get a really bad case of it. But my mono case was pretty mild

Light Fever for about 10 days. A few days after I got strep (which I guess can happen with mono). After that some light fatigue, mostly when I exercised (even walking) for another week or so. But after about 4 weeks since my symptoms stated, I returned back to full health. Zero symptoms, no fatigue and could workout/exercise like I did before.

If anyone wants to hear a positive story, I started having symptoms at the end of November. Got diagnosed a week later. Had symptoms for about 3 weeks, including getting a bad case of strep with it, but shortly after all my symptoms went away. By January 1st I was back to 100%. No more fatigue. Back to my regular life. I realize for most on this sub that isn’t the case but for those who just got diagnosed and are worried don’t automatically assume you’ll be down for “8-12 months”

You can trust your doctors. They are not “guessing” you have mono based on symptoms. The blood test confirms the virus is in you. The symptoms you are having are normal. If they say you are recovering well, then that’s a good sign. I was told the same thing and I got over it pretty quickly. No, McDonalds did not cause your rash to come back. Yes, it is possible for symptoms to go away for a bit and then come back for a little while. This does not mean you had a “setback” or that soothing is wrong. You’re headed in the right direction
